**Question:** Hang a stone of mass $10\text{ gm}$ from a string $1\text{ m}$ long. What is its time period?

**Answer:**
$$T = 2\pi \sqrt{\frac{l}{g}} = 2\pi \sqrt{\frac{1}{9.8}} \text{ s} = 2.0\text{ s}$$

The time period remains the same whether the mass of the stone is $10\text{ gm}$ or not. If you wish, by measuring the time period you can determine the value of $g$ just now. Try and see!
